label: Rust: Compile & Run Active File
command: if (Test-Path 'Cargo.toml') { if ($ZED_STEM -eq 'main') { cargo run } else { cargo run --bin $ZED_STEM } } else { rustc "$ZED_FILE" -o "$ZED_DIRNAME\$ZED_STEM.exe"; if ($?) { & "$ZED_DIRNAME\$ZED_STEM.exe" } }

label: Generate Boilerplate
command: $ext = [System.IO.Path]::GetExtension("$ZED_FILE").ToLower(); $txt = (Get-Content "$ZED_FILE" -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($txt)) { if ($ext -eq ".java") { $c = "import java.util.Scanner;`n`npublic class $ZED_STEM {`n    public static void main(String[] args) {`n        `n    }`n}" } elseif ($ext -in ".cpp", ".cc", ".cxx") { $c = "#include <bits/stdc++.h>`nusing namespace std;`n`nint main() {`n    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);`n    cin.tie(NULL);`n`n    `n`n    return 0;`n}" } elseif ($ext -eq ".py") { $c = "def main():`n    pass`n`nif __name__ == '__main__':`n    main()`n" } elseif ($ext -eq ".rs") { $c = "fn main() {`n    println!(`"Hello, world!`");`n}`n" } if ($c) { [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$ZED_FILE", $c, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)) } }
